a: Site Reliability Engineering applies software engineering to operations/reliability.
Toil is manual, repetitive, automatable operational work.
Error budgets define how much unreliability is acceptable for a period.
Blameless postmortems focus on systems and process, not personal blame.
Test IaC and deployment pipelines like application code.
GitOps uses Git as the source of truth for declarative cluster state.
Progressive delivery rolls out gradually (canary/blue-green) with metrics.
Platform teams build internal developer platforms to reduce cognitive load.
Good on-call: clear ownership, actionable alerts, runbooks, and handoffs.
Capacity planning forecasts resources needed for growth and peaks.
